text: THE WEBSITE'S REGISTERS ARE RE-READ FROM THE LIVE SITE (29 Sep 2026; last read 18 Sep). Documents, organisation pages, officials, events, photographs, vacancies, tenders, scheme pages and their documents now match dosje.gov.in, in all three website designs: two new DAIC internships, a new event and two photo albums, 41 new and 20 withdrawn organisation pages, 22 officials added and 24 withdrawn, and two old-site entries the Department removed from its scheme list (DAIC and the Ambedkar National Memorial, which were never schemes). The Department moved Babu Jagjivan Ram National Foundation to a new address; its pages are served at the estate's existing address so no link breaks. A file size printed with a thousands separator ("1,014.26 KB") now reads correctly instead of as 14 KB.
